rules: IAM owns subject identity, authentication and session semantics
IAM does not own authorization decisions for domain actions/resources
AccessCore is the authorization decision authority
DWH owns canonical website structural/resource resolution and declarative relations
WebEngine consumes IAM identity context but must not reinterpret IAM management tiers as application authorization
WebGUI and S3D do not depend on IAM identity semantics
the existing IAM implementation remains untouched until the parallel /app/iam candidate is proven
